title: Gemstone Ore
description: Adds New Ore Which means new armor, new tools, new raw ore, new gameplay!
body:
**💎 Gemstone Ore – A New Era of Mining

Gemstone Ore adds a brand new ore to the world, expanding Minecraft’s progression with powerful new materials, tools, armor, and fresh gameplay features.

Mine deep underground to discover Gemstone Ore, smelt it into Raw Gemstone, and craft a full set of high-tier equipment. This mod is designed to feel vanilla-friendly while still adding exciting new content to explore.

✨ Features

New Gemstone Ore generation in the world

New item: Raw Gemstone

Full Gemstone Tool Set (Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel, Hoe)

Full Gemstone Armor Set

Stronger than diamond (or configurable)

Balanced for survival gameplay

Perfect for modpacks and progression-based worlds

🎮 Gameplay

Gemstone Ore creates a new mining goal after diamond, giving players a reason to explore deeper caves and upgrade their gear. Whether you're fighting mobs or mining faster, Gemstone equipment changes how you play.

⚙️ Compatibility

Works with most modpacks

Vanilla-style progression

Lightweight and performance-friendly.**
